title: 13.8 Billion Years in 2 Minutes: The Cosmic Calendar
description:
What if the 13.8 billion-year history of the universe was squeezed into a single calendar year? From the Big Bang on January 1 to modern humans appearing just seconds before midnight on December 31, the cosmic calendar helps us grasp the immensity of time and our tiny place in it.

In this video, we compress the entire universe into 2 minutes, from the birth of galaxies and stars, to the formation of Earth, to the rise of life and human civilization. Edited from multiple sources, this visual timelapse reveals just how brief human history is compared to the vast timeline of the cosmos.

Learn how Carl Sagan’s idea of the cosmic calendar makes science, astronomy, and the story of life more accessible — and more humbling.

#CosmicCalendar #BigBang #UniverseTimeline
